THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.:-EMDS/LND/05/ACQ/02/08.Ministry of Land Reference No.:- 4-3/9/2012/IR/354.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the LandAcquisition ( Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that thegovernment intends to acquire the following land/Servitude.Which is required for a public purpose:-
